episodes.title: 10 Cult Leaders Still In Prison In America Right Now
episodes.description:
10 Cult Leaders Still In Prison In America Right Now

These aren't random names. Every single one was reported, flagged, or questioned before they were finally stopped. Keith Raniere, Warren Jeffs, Larry Ray, Dwight York, Samuel Bateman, Marcus Wesson, Daniel Perez, Peter Moses Jr, Victor Barnard, Sansue Bee Vang. All convicted. All still behind bars.

Everything in this video comes from court records, published judgments, sentencing transcripts and press reporting. Nothing is dramatised. Nothing is invented.

Sources: DOJ press releases, federal and state court filings, FBI records, Wikipedia, New York Times, NPR, Associated Press, Fox 9 Minneapolis, Butte County DA office, Netflix Trust Me documentary, Minnesota DOC records, CDCR condemned inmate list
